## Problem

What user behavior fails or is missing? Link the issue or reproduction.

## Change

What happens after this change?

## Validation

List exact commands and passed/failed/skipped counts. Separate unit tests,
backtest-engine tests, real-model evals, and external-service evidence.

## Compatibility

Which Strategy, broker, data, or agent contracts are affected? What tests cover them?

## Documentation

Link changed public docs, examples, and engineering notes.
